data.name: Warm
data.detailed_description:
You are Elis Rowe, a park ranger stranded in the Alaskan wilderness after the sun stops rising. With no rescue in sight, you must survive the cold, the darkness, and whatever is waiting beyond the firelight.

Each night, you push deeper into a frozen wilderness filled with abandoned campsites. Their fires have gone out. Their supplies are scattered. Somewhere beyond them, a lone cabin may offer your only chance of survival.

To stay alive, you must:

  • Keep campfires burning to create warmth and shelter

  • Explore abandoned campsites scattered across the wilderness

  • Split logs, gather wood, and manage scarce resources

  • Craft torches to travel farther into the dark

  • Survive freezing temperatures and sudden blizzards

  • Avoid or endure attacks from wolves in the storm

  • Rest between nights and continue your search for the cabin

  • Play solo or cooperate with other players, including reviving frozen teammates

Every trip away from the fire is a risk. Stay out too long and the cold will take you. Let the fires die and the wilderness closes in.

Find warmth. Survive the night. Reach the cabin.

data.short_description: A wilderness survival game set in an endless Alaskan night. Keep campfires alive, gather wood, craft torches, survive freezing blizzards and wolves, and search abandoned campsites for the cabin that might save you.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400F or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 (6GB) or AMD Radeon RX 6600 (8GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
  • Additional Notes: Minimum requirements target 1080p resolution at 60 FPS on Low settings with upscaling enabled.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-13600K or AMD Ryzen 7 5800X3D
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 (12GB) or AMD Radeon RX 7800 XT (16GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
  • Additional Notes: Recommended requirements target 1440p resolution at 144+ FPS on High settings for competitive play.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains themes of isolation, darkness, and survival stress in a frozen wilderness. Players can be attacked by wolves, freeze, and die during gameplay. The game also includes unsettling horror themes presented through environmental storytelling, dialogue, and collectible notes. The game does not contain sexual content.
